## CEOPRO AI - Pull Request Template

### Description
Provide a concise description of the architectural or feature changes introduced.

### Phase 1 Core Checklist
- [ ] Code strictly follows standard English naming conventions.
- [ ] No hardcoded passwords/secrets (Variables decoupled via `.env`).
- [ ] Strict Multi-Tenancy isolation is maintained (Uses exact `tenant_id` mapping).
- [ ] Asynchronous event schemas or database constraints adhere to agreed contracts.
- [ ] Dynamic connectivity or local mock validation tests passed successfully.
